pre_execution_questions.question: How to prepare Asset revision without weakening external-original trust?
pre_execution_questions.proposal: Metadata-only bytes Asset revision uses accepted pinned bank.original export; reopen returned private output via existing private File guards, verify expected exact length/hash/identity while streaming into immutable prepared payload. SelectedOriginal intentionally rejects app-owned output paths and is only for explicitly selected external replacement. Preserve display filename/media type; transport file_path may be normalized. Original replacement is explicit bytes→bytes or locator→locator; retain old versions/originals. No in-place BLOB edits or external input permission repair.

pre_execution_questions.question: What happens to a conflicting prepared edit?
pre_execution_questions.proposal: Publish/save/receipt explicit. Publication/prepared journal never claims Bank acceptance. STALE_BASE retains exact failed intent and shows conflict; exact retry remains same base/IDs. Explicit new edit reads current head and allocates new tx/revision; no automatic rebase or merge. UNKNOWN uses actual receipt and pinned manifest retry; journal damage never hides accepted Bank receipt.
